current.text: He is a rookie. The Kings traded up to pick 29 in the 2026 draft to take him.
Sacramento's projected starters are Acuff, LaVine, Hunter, Murray and Sabonis. He is not in that group.
Lloyd hated the pick and thought he looked bad in Summer League. He does not expect him to be a rotation player.
Rookie rankings put him below his draft slot.
Experts project the Kings near the bottom of the league.

durable.text: He is a low-usage player. His usage was 17% in college and 16.5% in Summer League, where he scored 8 points per game.
He entered the NBA at about 23 and a half, old for a rookie.
He is a good shooter who does little else. Experts compare him to a much worse Duncan Robinson or see a Steve Novak outcome.
His game translates poorly to fantasy. Even as a rotation player he has little fantasy appeal.

note: Do not draft him. Yahoo has him at 608 with a value of 0 USD, ESPN does not price him, and Lloyd does not expect him to make the rotation. Yahoo projects only 7.6 points and 1.4 threes on 41.7% shooting, below the pool average in every category except TO and FT%. Check early whether he gets real minutes on a bad Kings team. Even then he is only a deep-league threes streamer.
